heading.title: General Provisions as to Inquiries and Trials

article.title: Right of person against whom proceedings are instituted to be defended
article.content: Any person accused of an offence before a Criminal Court, or against whom proceedings are instituted under this Sanhita, may of right be defended by an advocate of his choice.
article.html:
340Right of person against whom proceedings are instituted to be defended

Section 340 · Chapter XXVI

Any person accused of an offence before a Criminal Court, or against whom proceedings are instituted under this Sanhita, may of right be defended by an advocate of his choice.
